coder_notes: Advanced solid tumour basket; glioblastoma appears only in keywords, not in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels (C7/D27B), so not_glioblastoma (fails S5); basket set false because GBM is not explicitly eligible. RANO-BM refers to brain metastases. LCB84 role differs by arm: experimental_monotherapy in 'LCB84 monotherapy', experimental_combination with anti-PD-1 in 'LCB84 + anti-PD-1'. Anti-PD-1 antibody is unnamed. Enrichment cohorts are mentioned but no enrichment biomarker (e.g. TROP2 expression) is stated, so no biomarker rows. PK is plasma only.
